utterances.Sentence: From Dino 11

utterances.Sentence: Well a mixed number is made up of a nonzero integer and a fraction

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: 1 12 2 34 27 38 these are all examples of mixed numbers

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: Moby and I are working on a mixed number right now

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: Were supposed to add 2 12 liters of oil for the car 2 12 really means 2  12

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: Converting a mixed number to a fraction is just a matter of adding two fractions

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: Well look at 2 12

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: To add 2 and 12 we write 2 as a fraction with a denominator of 2

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: 2 is the same thing as 42

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: Now adding them together is easy 42  12  52

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: A fraction like 52 with the numerator larger than the denominator is called an improper fraction

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: No theyre just called that

utterances.Sentence: Theres a shortcut for converting mixed numbers to fractions

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: Yes how much oil do we have leftover

utterances.Speaker: T

utterances.Speaker: T
utterances.Sentence: The shortcut is to multiply the whole number by the fractions denominator and then add the numerator to the result
